findings.title: Choosing 'Media' in the Japanese spine locks the device out of every Japanese lesson: each lesson page throws 'codeSpine.stageHead is not a function' and bounces to Home, and the switch back is on the page that no longer opens
findings.evidence: Repro (slot 10): open #/ref/ja/1.1, press 'Media' in the spine → console 'EXC TypeError: codeSpine.stageHead is not a function at hub.js:495'; then #/ref/ja/1.2, #/ref/ja/H1, #/ref/ja/2.1 all end on #/home with the toast; KOS.store.state.ui.japanese.spine === 'media'. Screenshot /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/ja-mind/q-spine-media2-mac.png (Home with 'A page could not be opened.'). Code: js/modules/jatopic.js:36-40 (media branch returns {tracks:true} only); js/modules/hub.js:491-495 (stageHead called whenever codeSpine is truthy).
findings.rootCause: Spine contract (stageHead) not honoured by the Media branch; caller does not guard
findings.fix: In jatopic.spine's media branch return a stageHead too (or have hub skip stage heads when codeSpine.tracks / when stageHead is missing: `if (codeSpine && codeSpine.stageHead && …)`), and render no sections under the Media note. Add a smoke test that opens a ja lesson with ui.japanese.spine = 'media'. Until the media release, consider hiding the Media segment.

findings.title: 'Held in reviews' (4th lesson check) is never written to the progress record by reviews, so the inspector shows 3/4 · 75% while the stored status, spine and unit counts stay behind
findings.evidence: eval: after reading all 8 pages of 1.1, finishLesson, and holding every item's R facet (reps 3, s 30): KOS.ja.evidence('1.1').checks = [true,false,true,true] but KOS.store.peekProgress('ja','1.1').check = [true,false,true,false] (also after rendering the topic page). Screenshot /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/ja-mind/q-1.1-heldmismatch-mac.png: inspector ticks 'Held in reviews 14 of 14 items held' and '3 of 4 checks 75%' beside status 'Started', spine 'F1 First conversations 0 / 6'.
findings.rootCause: Evidence that changes through the scheduler has no write path into the progress record
findings.fix: After KOS.ja.record()/finishSession(), call syncChecks for every lesson whose items were reviewed (map item → lesson), and run a one-pass syncChecks over all started lessons at boot (as Code's syncChecks is run), so the stored checks always equal evidence().

findings.title: Leaving a Japanese session by navigation (rail, tab bar, Back, iPad edge swipe, reload) logs nothing: answers are rescheduled but the session's XP and the day's study activity are lost
findings.evidence: eval slot 10: two kana R facets due; open #/japanese/session/reviews, answer さ correctly (facet reps 0 → 1), KOS.show('home') → new ledger entries 0, governor XP +0. js/modules/jarun.js:400-406 (leave only on ✕), :431-447 end(); no hashchange/pagehide/KOS.show hook in run().
findings.rootCause: Ledger write tied to an explicit end event; navigation tears the view down silently
findings.fix: Log the session on teardown: register a one-shot on the next KOS.show / router leave and on pagehide (as Focus banks on page hide, invariant 4c) that calls end(true) when results.length && !done; or log incrementally (one entry per session id, updated) so nothing depends on the exit path.

findings.title: iPhone: on a Japanese lesson the topic tab strip collapses to 5 px — Notes, Practice, Reviews and Files are invisible and the Practice session cannot be reached from the lesson
findings.evidence: Screenshot /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/ja-mind/q-1.2-scene-iphone.png (no tab row; arrow at the left edge under the header). eval (iphone): #/ref/ja/1.2, #/ref/code/1.1, #/ref/mind/F1.1 → tabs scroller width 5 px inside .k-topic-tabrow 370 px; arrows {Earlier material x 16 w 32}, {More material x −10.5 w 32}. css/views/study.css:208-218; js/modules/jatopic.js:85-90 (Learn/Reference segment added to the row).
findings.rootCause: Too many flex:none siblings beside a shrinkable scroller in one row
findings.fix: Under 700 px let .k-topic-tabrow wrap: tabs scroller on its own full-width line (flex-basis 100%), Working/Edit/Learn·Reference on a second line or in the ⋯ menu; give the scroller a min-inline-size (e.g. 50%).

findings.title: Japanese stage path labels truncate ('Intermedi...', 'Upper int...', 'Advanced' on iPad) on the desk hero and the Checkpoints page
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/ja-mind/e-ja-desk-mac.png (hero bottom row), /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/ja-mind/e-ja-checkpoints-mac.png; DOM measure: ELLIP b 'Intermediate' 828,396 69x19, 'Upper intermediate' 933,396 69x19 (mac); 559,612 52x19 / 642,612 / 724,612 (ipad)

findings.title: Touch targets under 44px in Japanese and Mind: stage-path checkpoints 21px wide, Journal kind chips 32px tall, Daily-minutes slider 16px tall
findings.evidence: DOM measure (pointer:coarse): ipadl ja.path-checkpoint '合' 305,641 21x44 and 3 more; iphone same at 68,548 21x44; ipadl/iphone button.k-mind-kindpick 'All · 9' 68x32 … 'Reflection · 2' 140x32; ja.daily-min 129x16 (ipad, iphone). css/views/mind.css:338 min-block-size: var(--hit) (32px) with no coarse override; css/components.css:677-684 raises only .k-btn/.k-seg-item/.k-menu-item/.k-rail-item/.k-iconbtn.

findings.fix: Under (pointer: coarse) give .k-mind-kindpick min-block-size var(--hit-coarse); give .k-ja-cp an invisible-free hit area of 44px wide (pad the node, not a pseudo overlap — invariant 69) or make the circle 28px with 8px spacing within a 44px column; give .k-range a 44px tall track box on coarse pointers.

findings.title: Japanese learn session asks Listening first and buries every Reading facet (sibling tie-break sorts 'L' before 'R')
findings.evidence: eval slot 10 after KOS.ja.startLesson('1.1'): due = [j:本|R, g:ka|L, g:kosoa|L, g:wa-desu|L, w:あれ|L, w:かさ|L, w:これ|L, …] (no word |R). Root: js/core/jasrs.js:105-107 sort tie-break (a.k < b.k) puts '|L' before '|R' when over and recall are equal (new facets: 0, 0), then :110-111 keeps only the first facet of each item.
findings.rootCause: Alphabetical key tie-break in the sibling-burying queue
findings.fix: In queue(), break ties by skill order (R, L, W, S, H) before the key string, or in jarun.run for a learn session take the lesson's facets from KOS.ja.peek().facets directly rather than the sibling-buried due() list.

findings.title: Sibling rule broken within a day: once one facet of an item is answered, its buried sibling becomes due the same day
findings.evidence: eval: KOS.ja.record('w:これ|L', {verdict:'correct',ms:2000}) then KOS.ja.due().indexOf('w:これ|R') >= 0 → true (same day 2026-11-05). js/core/jasrs.js:101-114 filters only by f.due <= today; no check of a sibling's f.last === today.
findings.rootCause: Burying is computed over the current due set only, with no 'reviewed today' memory
findings.fix: In queue(), skip a facet whose sibling has last === today (unless both are >2 days overdue), or push the buried sibling's due to tomorrow when its sibling is reviewed in record().

findings.title: One fast correct answer unlocks the Writing facet at once: 'R holds a week' is read as first-review stability ≥ 7 days, which a single Easy gives (s 8.3)
findings.evidence: eval after startLesson('1.1'): KOS.ja.record('w:これ|R',{verdict:'correct',hints:0,ms:2000}).unlocked = ['w:これ|W']; KOS.ja.record('g:ka|R',{…ms:3000}).unlocked = ['g:ka|W']; facet after one answer {s: 8.2956, ivl: 10}. js/core/jasrs.js:62 held = r.reps && r.s >= HOLD; js/core/jasrs.js:45 a correct answer within target → 4 (Easy) regardless of tries; js/core/ja.js:35 TARGET R 4000 ms.
findings.rootCause: Stability used as a proxy for elapsed holding time
findings.fix: Define 'holds a week' as evidence over time: reps >= 2 and a successful review at least 7 days after firstAt (or last - firstAt >= 7 with the last grade >= Good). Also cap a first-ever answer at Good, so a brand-new item is not pushed 10 days out by one tap.

findings.title: 'Passed the practice' ticks and the lesson pays 15 XP · 2 gold · +3 HP even when every answer in the learn session is wrong
findings.evidence: eval slot 10: startLesson('1.2'), record every due lesson facet {verdict:'wrong', ms:9000}, finishSession, finishLesson → {paid:true, pay:{xp:15,gold:2,hp:3}}, evidence('1.2').checks = [false,false,true,false], governor xp 0 → 15. Code: js/modules/jarun.js:435 'if (lessonId && !early && results.length) paidLesson = KOS.ja.finishLesson(lessonId)'; js/core/ja.js:234-245 (no pass test); js/core/ja.js:136 checks[2] = !!rec.doneAt.
findings.rootCause: Lesson completion is 'reached the end of the session', not 'passed'
findings.fix: Require a pass to finish: e.g. at least 60–70% of the lesson's graded answers Hard or better (or each item answered right at least once, re-asking the misses at the end of the session as Code/flashcards do). Otherwise end with 'Not passed yet — try the misses again', no pay, no doneAt. Rename the check if it only means 'finished the practice'.

findings.title: A Japanese leech (8 lapses) leaves the schedule for good: Rework rows are inert text with no way to relearn or put the facet back, and a leech looks the same as a 5-lapse item
findings.evidence: eval: w:ねこ|L lapses 8 → KOS.ja.due() excludes it, w:ペン|L lapses 5 → included; KOS.ja.rework() lists both. DOM: [data-ui~='ja.rework-row'] → DIV with 0 buttons/links. Screenshot /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/ja-mind/q-skills-rework-mac.png. Code: js/modules/japanese.js:238-247 (rows), :498 (the promise); js/core/jasrs.js:96,102 (leech filter); no unleech anywhere (grep).
findings.rootCause: Rework was drawn as a report, the relearn path was never built
findings.fix: Make each Rework row a button that opens the item's lesson at its Quick reference (or a mini learn session for that item), mark set-aside facets ('Set aside · 8 lapses'), and add KOS.ja.unleech(key) (lapses back to a base, as KOS.srs.unleech's leechBase) behind 'Back in the schedule'.

findings.title: Three promises the Japanese space cannot keep: 'Input this week' never fills (addInput has no caller), the Speaking switch changes nothing, and Licences say JMdict/KANJIDIC2/Tatoeba 'arrive with Stage 1' though Stage 1 shipped without them
findings.evidence: grep: 'addInput(' only at js/core/ja.js:291 (definition) and the export; js/modules/japanese.js:283-285 (empty-state promise), :656-657 (switch), :665 'row("Speech", …)', :674-676 (licence rows). js/core/ja.js:87-89 speech:false. No JMdict/Tatoeba reference in js/data/ja*.js or js/data/content/ja-*.js.
findings.rootCause: Pages drawn for the full plan before their features shipped
findings.fix: Hide the Input card (or wire a 'Japanese immersion' Focus choice that calls addInput) until it can be filled; hide or disable the Speech switch with 'arrives with the Speech release'; reword the licence rows to 'Arrives with the reader/dictionary' or drop them until used.

findings.title: Kana Writing reviews show the answer: the model glyph sits beside the pad on every review, so 'Write it' is a copying exercise graded as recall
findings.evidence: Screenshot /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/ja-mind/q-sessk2-ipad.png (Reviews 2/4, Writing · A · write it, model あ shown beside the pad). js/modules/jarun.js:142-146 builds the model, :167 appends it always; :148 'first' only controls the animation.
findings.rootCause: The learn-time layout is reused for reviews
findings.fix: Show the model only on the first meeting (reps 0) and as a 'Show the model' hint that counts as a hint (grade Hard) afterwards; prompt with the romaji reading only ('Write: a').

findings.title: Grades are more lenient than the rules say: a retry after 'near' can still grade Easy, and a stroke check 'accepted' (a stroke 'a little off', even ね drawn as two straight lines) is upgraded to 'correct'
findings.evidence: eval slot 10: KOS.jaStroke.check('ね', straight lines start→end of each KanjiVG stroke).verdict = 'accepted'; shift +11 → 'accepted' for あぬめねさ ('near' for き); scaled 0.6 → 'correct' (あぬめね). Code: js/modules/jarun.js:104-106 (finish passes hints, ms only), :150 ('accepted' → 'correct'); js/core/jasrs.js:40-47; js/core/jastroke.js:66 OK=13 / OFF=24 in a 109 box.
findings.rootCause: Result object lacks tries; verdict upgrade in the runner
findings.fix: Pass tries into the result and grade Easy only when tries === 1; keep the stroke verdict 'accepted' (Good, show its note); consider tightening OFF for long curved strokes (e.g. compare curvature/turning angle, not only mean point distance).

findings.title: '▶ Practise again' on a finished lesson opens an empty session ('Nothing due right now') and sends you to the desk, not back to the lesson
findings.evidence: eval: lesson 1.1 done, all its facets due 2026-12-30 → #/japanese/session/learn-1.1 → 'Nothing due right now · Back to the desk'. Screenshot /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/ja-mind/q-practise-again-empty-mac.png.
findings.rootCause: The learn session reuses the due queue, which is empty after the first finish
findings.fix: For a finished lesson run an unscheduled practice over its items (self-contained, record nothing or record as practice that moves no facet), or hide 'Practise again' when nothing of the lesson is due and say when its items come back. 'Back to the desk' should return to the lesson when the session was opened from it.

findings.title: Media path projects absurd ranges from thin evidence ('Graded reader Level 1 · 2032 – 2084', 'A light novel · 2180 – 3559') once two weeks pass with a single word met
findings.evidence: eval fixture: facets {k:あ|R firstAt −20d, w:これ|R firstAt −10d} → KOS.ja.timeline() {calibrating:false, perWeek:{lo:0,mid:1,hi:1}, Graded reader 2032-07-29 → 2084-02-24, Yotsuba 2049 → 2256}. Screenshot /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS - Web/audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/ja-mind/q-path-thin-mac.png. findings.title: Checkpoints are easier than '80% in every skill' suggests: the Hiragana checkpoint's 6 Listening questions are 3 two-choice items each asked twice identically, and the Writing section shows the model kana to copy
findings.evidence: js/modules/japanese.js:593 (sounds.concat(sounds)), :589-590 (pick seeded by the day); js/modules/jarun.js:31-34 (minimal pair seeded by key + today), :142-146/167 (model always shown). eval: cp-H unit has exactly 3 sound items ['s:voicing','s:sokuon','s:long'].
findings.rootCause: Too few listening items padded by duplication; one exercise renderer for learn, review and test
findings.fix: Draw 6 distinct pairs across the three items' pair lists (each item has several pairs) with a per-question seed; hide the model in checkpoint Writing; seed the selection per attempt (Date.now()) rather than per day.

findings.title: Kana page: switching Mixed / Read / Write mid-set (or leaving without 'End set') throws the set's answers away unlogged
